steps.label: KDE CAN LEAK PAST LIMITS
steps.sub: Curve dips below zero — not real

eyebrow: The 1.5 x IQR fence, computed by hand
code:
q1, q3 = x.quantile([.25, .75])
iqr = q3 - q1
fence = q3 + 1.5 * iqr
print(round(fence, 2), (x > fence).sum())
# 87.82  283
caption: 283 of 5,000 values (5.7%) flagged -- a lot, for a right-skewed variable.

eyebrow: The outlier rule is a flag, not a verdict

steps.label: NEVER DELETE ON SIGHT
steps.sub: A circle on a box plot is a lead, not proof

code:
x.hist(bins=3)    # 4,759 of 5,000 in ONE bar -- shape invisible
x.hist(bins=30)   # this works well
x.hist(bins=300)  # tallest bar only 171 -- jagged, noisy
caption: Try more than one bin setting before trusting a shape, especially a small bump.
